name: filter.rename
title: Rename saved filter
summary: Give a saved filter a new name; its file is renamed to match, and the perspectives that use it are changed with it.
details: The new name is checked as when saving and must not be another saved filter's, in any case or Unicode normal form; changing only the case of the own name is allowed, and the same name writes nothing. The file is named as a new file for the new name would be, the own file not counted as taken; when the name part without a suffix is its file name in any case, the file name stays. Every perspective that names the filter, also one hidden by a file with the same name, gets the new name first (only its `filter` line), the filter last; `perspectives` lists them. A script that calls the filter by its old name no longer finds it. Errors: input.invalid at `name` when no saved filter has it, at `newName` when another one has it (details.files); input.invalid with details.reason referenced when a baseline file names the filter (details.files; ReqSeq never changes a baseline file); file.faulty when only a faulty file holds either name, or a faulty perspective or baseline file names the filter or a perspective or baseline file does not read as YAML (details.files); file.folder-missing when the repository of the filters, perspectives or baselines folder is not on this machine (details.repository); file.faulty when the perspectives or baselines folder cannot be listed; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder for a place in Git (D-036); file.changed-on-disk when a file changed since it was read. Nothing is written on these. A write that fails part-way names the files already changed in details.written (nothing is rolled back) and the same call again finishes the rename; the filter file is renamed back when its name cannot be written, and named in details.written only if that fails too.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-217 AK7: renaming is refused while the tool refuses write commands (SR-011 AK3).
